title: MITRE ATT&CK u detekciji
summary: Mapiranje detekcija na MITRE ATT&CK (v20, sa taktikama Stealth i Defense Impairment), mjerenje pokrivenosti i pravljenje ATT&CK Navigator slojeva iz Wazuh i Sigma pravila.
summary_en: Mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK (v20, with the Stealth and Defense Impairment tactics), measuring coverage, and building ATT&CK Navigator layers from Wazuh and Sigma rules.
